Image 1: Eleven-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Ji Ran, look S2) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Subject 2 (Xu Banxia) character appearance reference.
Image 10: Subject 3 (GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT) character appearance reference.
Image 11: Subject 4 (BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT) character appearance reference.
Image 12: Subject 5 (GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT) character appearance reference.
Image 13: Subject 6 (SHIRTLESS APPLICANT, look S0) character appearance reference.
Image 14: Prop 1 (small dumbbell) maps to this image; copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 14.
From each prop's image, use only structure, material, and color.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Ji Ran): Refer to Image 8. 27, Heroine; owner of Jiejian Company, daughter of Ji Hongyuan, and ex-girlfriend of Lu Shaoze. Outfit: look S2: Interview day at the office: a crimson sleeveless bodycon sheath dress with a square neckline and a cinched waist, hemmed at mid-thigh. Black patent stiletto pumps, diamond studs and a gold watch. Signature colour: red.
Subject 2 (Xu Banxia): Refer to Image 9. 24, Ji Ran's secretary at Jiejian Company. Outfit: A fitted white long-sleeve blouse tucked into a mustard-yellow high-waisted pencil skirt, nude block-heel pumps and a lanyard-free slim staff badge clip. Gold-rimmed glasses. Signature colour: yellow.
Subject 3 (GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT): Refer to Image 10. 26, Husband-audition applicant who shows off with a dumbbell. Outfit: A fitted kelly-green short-sleeve polo-style shirt, black slim trousers and black sneakers. Signature colour: green.
Subject 4 (BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT): Refer to Image 11. 27, Husband-audition applicant who throws an awkward punch. Outfit: A royal-blue athletic tank top, grey jogger trousers and white sneakers. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 5 (GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT): Refer to Image 12. 25, Husband-audition applicant who claims eight-pack abs. Outfit: A tight heather-grey short-sleeve T-shirt, black slim trousers and black sneakers. Signature colour: grey.
Subject 6 (SHIRTLESS APPLICANT): Refer to Image 13. 28, The fourth husband-audition applicant, who strips off his top and flexes. Outfit: look S0: A tight black short-sleeve T-shirt, bright orange track trousers and white sneakers. Signature colour: orange.
Environment (JI RAN'S OFFICE): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Day, bright soft daylight from the windows behind the desk. Bright soft daylight comes through the floor-to-ceiling windows behind and to the left of the desk, and warm recessed ceiling spots fill in from above. Live sound: quiet office room tone, heels on the floor and the light shuffle of the men's sneakers.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 10 lines, in this order: Xu Banxia, Ji Ran, GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, Ji Ran, BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, Ji Ran, GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, Ji Ran, APPLICANTS (V.O.), Ji Ran. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Strictly exclude]
subtitles or garbled text. readable lettering on the wall sign. the four applicants speaking in perfect unison as one voice. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Characters or props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (11 shots, approximately 24 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
At the start: Ji Ran sits upright in the one black leather executive chair behind the one walnut desk. Her back is to the floor-to-ceiling windows, and she faces the open space in front of the desk. She wears the crimson sleeveless bodycon sheath dress. The desk holds architectural plans, wood samples and a metal figurine. The four applicants stand in one row in the open space in front of the desk, facing her. From the lounge end of the room they stand in this order: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, who holds the small dumbbell at his side, then BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, then GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, then SHIRTLESS APPLICANT in his black T-shirt. Xu Banxia walks from the black leather sofas and the white marble coffee table of the lounge area toward the lounge end of the desk. The office door is in the wall facing the desk. It stands open and empty. The axis runs from the desk to the door wall, and the camera stays on the lounge side of it.
Shot 1 (0-3s): [Wide shot, slow push in, eye-level, from the lounge side of the room. The desk is at frame right and the row of applicants is at frame left.] Xu Banxia walks past the marble coffee table to the lounge end of the walnut desk and bends slightly toward Ji Ran. Ji Ran sits in the leather executive chair, and the four applicants stand in a row in front of the desk. Dialogue (Xu Banxia, in Chinese, brisk and polite): {纪总，候选人都已经到了。} <heels click on the floor>
Shot 2 (3-5s): [Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran leans back in the leather chair with her long legs crossed. Her eyes sweep coolly along the row of men. Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, flat and clipped): {身高？}
Shot 3 (5-7s): [Medium shot, quick push in, low angle, from the lounge side.] GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, at the lounge end of the row, straightens his back and grins eagerly. The small dumbbell hangs in his hand. Dialogue (GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT, in Chinese, eager): {一米七九。}
Shot 4 (7-9s): [Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran's gaze slides one place along the row, and she taps one finger on the walnut desk. Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, deadpan): {体重？}
Shot 5 (9-11s): [Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, from the lounge side.] BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, second in the row, puffs out his chest and plants his fists on his hips. Dialogue (BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, in Chinese, hearty): {七十五公斤。}
Shot 6 (11-13s): [Medium close-up, slight push in, high angle, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran raises one eyebrow and rests her chin on her hand. Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, dry): {有腹肌？}
Shot 7 (13-15s): [Medium shot, locked-off camera, low angle, from the lounge side.] GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, third in the row, smugly pats his stomach through the tight grey T-shirt. Dialogue (GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, in Chinese, smug): {八块。}
Shot 8 (15-17s): [Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran presses her glossy lips together to hold back a smile, and the corner of her mouth twitches.
Shot 9 (17-19s): [Medium close-up, quick push in, eye-level, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran leans forward over the walnut desk with her forearms on the plans and looks straight at the row. Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, cool and pointed): {能干吗？}
Shot 10 (19-22s): [Wide shot, fast pan along the row from the lounge end to the far end, eye-level, from the lounge side.] The four applicants start with wide eyes and nod frantically one after another, from GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT to SHIRTLESS APPLICANT, as the chorus is heard. Dialogue (APPLICANTS, V.O., in Chinese, a ragged startled chorus): {啊？呃能能能。}
Shot 11 (22-24s): [Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge side.] Ji Ran sits back in the leather chair and lifts one hand in a lazy go-ahead gesture. Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, flat): {来吧，展示。}
At the end: Ji Ran sits in the black leather executive chair behind the walnut desk, her back to the floor-to-ceiling windows, with one hand raised in a go-ahead gesture. The four applicants stand in one row in the open space in front of the desk, facing her. From the lounge end they stand in this order: GREEN-SHIRT APPLICANT holding the small dumbbell at his side, then BLUE-TANK-TOP APPLICANT, then GRAY-SHIRT APPLICANT, then SHIRTLESS APPLICANT still in his black T-shirt. Xu Banxia stands at the lounge end of the desk, facing the applicants. The office door in the wall facing the desk stands open and empty. The camera stays on the lounge side of the desk-to-door axis.
